title: De minimis stays suspended for all countries (EO 14388)
summary: Executive Order 14388 keeps duty-free de minimis treatment off for covered shipments of any value, origin or mode, for goods entered from 12:01 a.m. EST on February 24, 2026. Postal items pay a duty equal to the Proclamation 11012 surcharge rate until that surcharge expires or CBP's postal entry process takes effect, whichever comes first.

title: IEEPA tariffs terminated (EO 14389)
summary: Executive Order 14389 terminates IEEPA additional duties under listed orders, including the reciprocal tariffs. It does not affect other duties such as Section 232 and Section 301.

title: 10% temporary import surcharge for 150 days (Proclamation 11012)
summary: A 10 percent ad valorem surcharge under section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974 applies from February 24, 2026 through 12:01 a.m. EDT on July 24, 2026, unless suspended, modified or terminated earlier or extended by an Act of Congress, with exceptions including Section 232 articles and goods of Canada or Mexico entered duty-free under general note 11.

title: Section 232 steel, aluminum and copper regime revised (Proclamation 11032)
summary: Proclamation 11032 sets a 25 percent rate for Annex I-C steel and aluminum articles unless a lower rate applies, for goods entered from 12:01 a.m. EDT on June 8, 2026 through December 31, 2027.

title: CBP suspends de minimis for express and cargo shipments (CBP Dec. 26-12)
summary: CBP Dec. 26-12, effective June 24, 2026, suspends the $800 de minimis exemption in 19 CFR 10.151 for merchandise arriving by every mode other than the international postal network.

title: CBP suspends de minimis for mail and adds postal informal entry (CBP Dec. 26-13)
summary: CBP Dec. 26-13, effective July 24, 2026, makes a postal informal entry process available for shipments valued at $2,500 or less.

agency: Office of the U.S. Trade Representative
title: New Section 301 duties on products of 60 investigated economies
summary: USTR imposes additional Section 301 duties of 10 or 12.5 percent, some net of the MFN rate, on products of economies in 60 investigations entered from 12:01 a.m. ET on July 24, 2026. Articles of aluminum, steel or copper and products of Canada or Mexico entered duty-free under the USMCA are exempt.

title: FY2027 customs user fees: MPF minimum $34.58, maximum $670.86
summary: CBP Dec. 26-14 keeps the MPF rate at 0.3464 percent and sets the formal-entry minimum and maximum at $34.58 and $670.86, required as of October 1, 2026. For fiscal year 2027 the MPF on an automated informal entry is $2.77.

title: CBP information collection for court-ordered IEEPA refunds
summary: CBP seeks comment, due November 4, 2026, on the data importers submit through the ACE Portal to request refunds of IEEPA duties after the Supreme Court's February 20, 2026 ruling in Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump.

agency: Office of the U.S. Trade Representative
title: China Section 301 tariffs continue after four-year review start
summary: USTR states that the July 6, 2018 Section 301 action on China, as modified, did not terminate on July 6, 2026 and remains in effect.

title: Proposed rule on low-value shipments and informal entry
summary: CBP published its Low-Value Shipments proposed rule on October 8, 2026. Comments are due December 7, 2026.

title: Postal formal-entry compliance date moved to January 20, 2027
summary: CBP extended the compliance date for the postal formal-entry provisions in 19 CFR 145.12(a)(2)(v) and (vi) to January 20, 2027.

title: Interim rule sets heightened requirements for foreign importers of record
summary: CBP published an interim final rule with request for comments on foreign importers of record. It takes effect January 5, 2027, and comments are due on or before that date. See the importer-of-record guide for what it changes.
